note: The committed shape of the bridgeworks' own self-check battery (lib/selfcheck.mjs, run by `gamestruct check`). The status emitter (web/scripts/build-status.mjs) runs the live battery and reconciles it against this list: a check that passes reads PASS, a check whose name is missing from the live run reads RED (a silently-deleted check is a smaller green, refused), and any live check not listed here reads RED (an unlisted check is unaccounted-for coverage). Edit this file in the same commit that adds or removes a check.
